LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.Title: Agent Translation
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ModeSimpleTip: Shows only what most players need. Switch to advanced mode for every option and the full report.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ModeAdvancedTip: All options, the in-game check and the full report.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.HowTo1: 1. Connect rwat to your AI tool (for example the Claude app). The README explains how.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.HowTo2: 2. Ask your AI assistant: "Translate my active mods and build the translation pack."
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.HowTo3: 3. Restart the game, enable "Agent Translation Pack" in the mod list and keep it last.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.SimpleNextWait: the check runs by itself at the main menu and after a save loads.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.SimpleNoPack: No translation pack is active yet.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.SimpleNextLanguag: set the pack language below to the game language, ask your AI assistant to rebuild the pack, then restart the game.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.SimpleAllOk: All {0} translations of the pack are in effect.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.SimpleNextMore: to translate more mods, ask your AI assistant to continue and rebuild the pack, then restart the game.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.SimpleSomeProblem: {0} of {1} translations are in effect; {2} are not (often another mod or patch already translates them).
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.SimpleNextAdvance: switch to advanced mode to see which mods are affected. Nothing needs fixing unless the text looks wrong in game.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ShowCornerButton: Button in the bottom-right icon row
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ShowCornerButtonT: A small icon next to the game's own toggles (zones, beauty, ...). Opens this page.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ShowTabButton: Button in the bottom tab bar
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ShowTabButtonTip: A small tab button next to Menu at the bottom of the screen. Opens this page.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ReportEnabledTip: After loading, check which translations of the pack are in effect and write the result for the rwat tool.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ReloadEnabled: Experimental: allow reloading Keyed translations without restarting
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ReloadEnabledTip: Only Keyed texts (UI strings) are reloaded. Def names and descriptions still need a restart. Some texts cached at startup may not update.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.NoPack: The translation pack was not found among active mods.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.LanguageMismatch: The pack is for {0}, but the game language is {1}. Its translations are not loaded.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.Summary: Pack entries: {0}. In effect: {1} ({6} with text added by another mod). Overridden by another mod: {2}. Changed at runtime: {3}. Not loaded or not injected: {4}. Unknown: {5}.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ErrorCount: Translation errors reported by the game for this language: {0}
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ProblemsHeader: Mods with entries not in effect:
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.LanguageTip: The language your AI assistant translates into. "Follow the game language" suits most players.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.CodeKeys: Translate keys that mods forgot to define
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.CodeKeysTip: Some mods show raw key names (such as Some.Key.Name) even in English. When on, your AI assistant infers a text from the key name; each one is marked as inferred.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.AutoAdopt: Traditional mode: adopt existing Simplified translations automatically
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.AutoAdoptTip: Converts existing Simplified translations to Traditional and uses them directly, under the conditions set in config.json. Only has an effect when the pack language is Traditional Chinese.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ToolSettingsNote: Changes are saved to rwat's config.json and take effect after you restart your AI assistant.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ToolSettingsSaved: Saved to config.json. Restart your AI assistant to apply.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ToolSettingsMissi: rwat's settings file was not found ({0}). Run rwat once first.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ToolSettingsError: The settings file could not be read or written ({0}).
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.ToolSettingsCusto: The bridge folder is set with RWAT_BRIDGE_DIR, so rwat's settings file cannot be located. Edit config.json directly.
LanguageData.AgentTranslationBridge.QuickButtonTip: Agent Translation: settings and translation status
